_provenance: Decks: written by SpiceRack (tests/test_monte_carlo.rs spectre_run_decks_are_current) from the SPICE sources in that test. Closed forms: by hand (v(out) of a 1k/1k divider, linearized: dv/dR1 = -2.5e-4 per ohm). ngspice: ngspice 45, N=2000 operating points re-drawn by mc_source, on the original SPICE deck. Tolerances: mean within 4*sigma/sqrt(N), std within 4*sigma/sqrt(2N) (N=2000); Spectre's default 4-sigma truncation changes a std by -0.054%, far inside them.

t_s1_nominal.scs.why: every call at its nominal: r1 = 1k + 0 + 0

t_s3_mismatch.scs.why: variations=mismatch: the shared process draw g is off; each instance's rl = agauss(1k,100,1) is its own

t_s3_nested.scs.why: x1.xa, x1.xb, x2.xa and x2.xb are four instances of leaf: four independent draws (hierarchical instances, R19 'per subcircuit instance')

t_m1_resistors.scs.why: 1 mA into each resistor model at 60 C (tests/test_model_kinds.rs RESISTORS): the closed forms there, which ngspice 45 meets to 1e-11; etch/etchl per side, ngspice's l=w=10u defaults, 1 mOhm with no r and no rsh, scale and m folded into m

t_m2_capacitors.scs.why: 1 uA into each capacitor model for 1 us at 60 C (CAPACITORS): v = 1e-12/C less the 1e12-ohm leak's t/(2RC); ngspice 45's values; cj/cjsw geometry, ngspice's w=10u default, scale folded into m

t_m3_diodes.scs.why: level-3 diodes (DIODES: a made-up one and sky130's ndiode) forward through 1k from 2 V and in breakdown from -20 V at 60 C; ngspice 45's values at its reltol=1e-3 (VACASK's ngspice-code diode lands within it). Spectre's level=3 diode with its own junction equations (no hcomp): the test of the mapping

t_m4_dependent.scs.why: r={1k*(1+0.1*abs(v(a)))} with 1 mA: v = 1/0.9 (DEPENDENT); ngspice runs it as a B source, its model and w, l, dtemp unread. The tolerance is Spectre's: its default reltol=1e-3 stops the Newton loop at 1.11 (rel 1.0e-3; with options reltol=1e-9, 1.11111111111), Spectre 25.1 on iccad4, settle-remote 2026-11-07
